index_fingerprint.description: SHA-256 over the canonical JSON of the effective physical index shape: catalog schema version, per-field physical projection (type/stored/docValues/multiValued/analyzer/roles/vector dimension+similarity), analyzer fingerprint, vector storage format, HNSW build parameters, chunking parameters, and the embedding + SPLADE model digests. The one rebuild-requiring parity key. Absent when a configured model's digest could not be resolved, because an indeterminate input must not be stamped as an identity (tempdoc 915).

index_fingerprint_inputs.description: The canonical JSON that index_fingerprint is the SHA-256 of, stamped verbatim. Present even when index_fingerprint is absent: when a configured model's digest is unresolvable the digest cannot be computed truthfully, but every input that model does not touch (field shapes, vector dimension/similarity, analyzers, chunking, HNSW, analysis library versions) is still known. Whenever EITHER side lacks a digest -- this runtime now, or the commit then -- the parity guard compares these renderings minus the model keys neither side can state unambiguously, instead of declining outright (tempdoc 931 C.5). Not a parity key of its own -- it is the same statement as index_fingerprint, and comparing both would report one shape change twice.

embedding_model_sha256.description: SHA-256 fingerprint of the embedding model GGUF file used to generate vectors in this index. Optional for legacy indexes; when present, vector/hybrid queries require a matching current model.

embedding_model_assets_sha256.description: Companion assets and effective output configuration, separate from the graph checksum. Compared only when both identities are present; graph-only indexes adopt it without rebuilding.

splade_model_assets_sha256.description: Companion assets and effective output configuration, separate from the graph checksum. Compared only when both identities are present; graph-only indexes adopt it without rebuilding.

ner_model_assets_sha256.description: Companion assets and effective output configuration, separate from the graph checksum. Compared only when both identities are present; graph-only indexes adopt it without rebuilding.

vector_format.description: Vector storage format used in this index. float32 = standard HNSW, int8_sq = scalar-quantized HNSW.

splade_model_sha256.description: SHA-256 fingerprint of the SPLADE sparse encoder ONNX model. When present, indicates the sparse encoding model version used for this index.
